Sun.jeeva: Father, Son, Right Eye, right side of body
Sun.ajeeva: Government, Name/Fame, Status, Authority, Ego, Administration, Leadership, Soul (Atma), Bones, Heart, Immunity, premium/branded items

Moon.jeeva: Mother, Eldest Daughter, Eldest Sister, 3rd Wife (male chart)
Moon.ajeeva: Mind (Manas), Change, Travel, Water, Food, Milk, Emotions, Hormones, Mood swings, Losses, fast-moving vehicles

Mars.jeeva: Younger Brother, Husband (female chart), Male Friend
Mars.ajeeva: Energy, Anger, Aggression, Stubbornness, Courage, risk-taking, Land, Property, Machines, Technical skills, Engineering, Surgery, Sports, Weapons

Mercury.jeeva: Youngest sibling, Friends, Relatives, Neighbours, 2nd Wife (male chart), Youngest Daughter, boyfriend/girlfriend
Mercury.ajeeva: Intelligence (Buddhi), Communication, Education, Business, Commerce, Trade, Media, Journalism, Skin, Logic, Analysis

Jupiter.ajeeva: Wisdom, Knowledge, Spirituality, Religion, Holy Books, Temples, Dharma, Finance, Fat, Space, Dignity, Prestige

Venus.jeeva: Wife (male chart)/the female herself (female chart), Daughter, Sister, Female Friend
Venus.ajeeva: Money, Luxury, Comforts, Vehicles, House, Fine Arts, Beauty, Pleasure, Relationships, Marriage

Saturn.ajeeva: Discipline, Hardship, Delay, Obstacles, Profession/Career, Longevity, Iron, Old age, Justice, Real estate, Mining

Rahu.ajeeva: Illusion (Maya), Foreign lands, Sudden events, Materialism, Technology, Unconventional paths, Obsession, Poison, Smoke

Ketu.ajeeva: Moksha, Detachment, Spirituality, Occult, Past life, Isolation, Loss of identity, Surgery, Sudden endings
